_doc: Pemakar at Lanternfall night: crabs on the harbour quay at the water's edge, away from the lamps. Gulls roost at night (the day variant has none yet). The sea is a greybox slab, so no fish. Placed on the greybox layout (M3-CRE-615); move the coordinates when env-art's kit replaces the blocks (same keys as ch02_haluna.json). Insects (M3-CRE-616): two moth swarms at the lamp posts (z -36 and -24, y 2.2) and a dragonfly patrol over the paddies (for the day variant, B11; a night zone that does not want them can drop the row).
